business_summary.text: Adani Energy Solutions runs transmission (about 28,000 circuit km), urban distribution in Mundra and Mumbai, India's largest smart metering platform, and a new Energy Solutions business supplying power to C&I, data centre and utility customers.

guidance.statement: FY27 capex will be around ₹21,000 to ₹22,000 Cr.
Expects ₹20,000-25,000 Cr of transmission capex addition every year at about 25% market share
Expects about ₹1 lakh Cr of transmission bidding opportunity a year combining central and state projects
Targets 7.5 GW of Energy Solutions market opportunity by 2031

operating_notes.text: Mumbai HVDC project fully commissioned in March 2026, contributing a full-year tariff of ₹1,300 Cr in FY27.
Energy Solutions has tied up about 5,000 MW of green supply, of which roughly 4,000 MW is from AVL and the rest from third parties, plus 3,500 MWh of battery storage on take-or-pay contracts.
Smart meter installations reached 1.34 Cr against an order book of 2.46 Cr; with IntelliSmart the combined portfolio would be about 4.7 Cr meters.
Long-term PPA sales realised ₹1,838 Cr on 3,325 MUs in Q1FY27, with bilateral contract tenures of 1 to 13 months and prices ranging from ₹3 to ₹13-15 per unit.

segment_mix.segment: Energy Solutions - power management services and trading

timeline.summary: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd scheduled a Q4FY26 results conference call with CEO Kandarp Patel, CFO Kunjal Mehta, and Head Finance Prashant Soni on April 24, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹7,443.27 Cr (+16.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹683.78 Cr.
Adani Energy Solutions submitted the audio recording link for its Q4FY26 results investor call held on April 24, 2026.
ICRA assigned AA+ (Stable) to Adani Energy Solutions' proposed limits and reaffirmed A1+ commercial paper on April 27, 2026.
Adani Energy Solutions held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding FY27 capex to ₹21,000-22,000 Cr and highlighting the commissioning of the Mumbai HVDC project.
S.B. Adani Family Trust (via **Pritamkumar Pritamkumar Nenmal Shah**) declared no new encumbrances on Adani Energy Solutions shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Adani Energy Solutions submitted its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY25-26.
Adani Energy Solutions incorporated seven wholly owned subsidiaries on June 1, 2026.
On its 22 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, AESL said its new Energy Solutions vertical earned ₹570 Cr EBIT on ₹1,838 Cr of long-term PPA sales (3,325 MUs), with only 400-500 MUs on signed C&I contracts.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹10,075.54 Cr (+52.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹1,322.85 Cr (+147.7% YoY).
